study_design: Prospective case-cohort analysis within the Netherlands Cohort Study on Diet and Cancer
reason: The abstract states that analyses were conducted for all prostate cancer cases and provides no stage, grade, metastatic, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint. Although 58,279 men were enrolled in the source cohort, the analytic case-cohort participant total is not reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Analyses were carried out for all prostate cancer cases. The prostate cancer rate ratio for men who had lived in a western Netherlands city in 1944-1945 was 1.15 (95% confidence interval (CI): 0.80, 1.31), and the rate ratio for men who had lived in a western rural area in 1944-1945 was 1.30 (95% CI: 0.97, 1.73).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported rate ratio concerns all prostate cancer cases, with no aggressive subtype established.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
